`. Practice presentations with us using [Presentation Coaching Tools](https://www.darshanaiitech.com/presentcoach).

`### Application Process (Week 11-12)
*Objective(s):*
Submit your application for the Internship position at reputed institutions and universities.
`. Here are some [Application Tips](https://www.darshanaiitech.com/applicationtips).
`Remember, I'm here to help you every step of the way with any questions or guidance on your learning journey! Keep up the excellent work towards ach0ctivity and stay curious! Take your time.
